pin.estimand: Target-runtime, different-input replication of 6ed658d5: equal-item current-tokenizer cost over 32 balanced formal permission/penalty claims against complete careful-English mappings; least-favourable tokenizer mean.
admissibility_gates: Exactly 32 unique complete pairs, balanced 16 sanction-allow and 16 sanction-penalize.
Exact (english,ainglish) byte-pair intersection with target 6ed658d5 is empty before tokenizer import.
Every marker arm names a resolved authority and bounded formal act; each comparator is its complete careful-English mapping.
cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base must all encode every pair finitely under target-matched tiktoken 0.13.0.
Every finite result is filed once regardless of agreement, sign, or proposal consequence.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-item aggregate mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete careful English reporting formal permission or a formally imposed penalty by the same named authority

manifest.freeze: The final target-matched runtime and exact target-disjoint pair set are stored by the API before tokenizer import or count exposure.
manifest.method: After stored-manifest mint, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair and tokenizer. Average all 32 items equally for each tokenizer. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable aggregate headline and the tokenizer span as value_lo/value_hi. Form-specific means are descriptive only because the target original is aggregate-only. File every finite result once regardless of agreement, sign, or proposal consequence.
manifest.population: 32 fresh complete authority-and-act pairs, balanced 16 sanction-allow and 16 sanction-penalize; form labels are diagnostic only
manifest.selection: All authorities, targets, formal acts, complete renderings, and the 16/16 balance were authored before target-manifest inspection or tokenizer import. Each marker arm states an explicit resolved authority and bounded act or penalty; each comparator is the proposal's complete careful-English formal-permission or formal-penalty disclosure. Capability, prediction, informal tolerance, unexecuted penalty inference, authority validity, and legal-compliance claims are excluded. Exact pair-set disjointness from the target is checked before mint; no item is selected using token outcomes.
